correctness.rationale: For arbitrary strictly positive triangle sides obeying triangle inequalities, independently parameterize all nine ordered edge pairs and integrate squared and fourth Euclidean distances exactly. The resulting symmetric moment identities and Heron identity algebraically give unique area, second and third side elementary symmetric functions; their cubic uniquely determines the unordered side multiset. Exact symbolic evaluation passed and the positive-area denominator is explicitly required. An exact noncongruent equal-perimeter equal-second-moment example confirms necessity of extra information.
